summary: Both new theorems are genuinely new mathematics and reuse the isoperimetric inequality, the Cauchy–Schwarz lemma and Mathlib's measure plumbing correctly. But the new ball-Caccioppoli proof re-derives four blocks that already exist almost verbatim in Regularity/LocalBoundedness.lean and Caccioppoli/Basic.lean; these should be factored into shared lemmas instead of cloned.
